mapper.select: select company.dept_name companyName,company.dept_id companyDeptId,coalesce(c.country_region_snapshot,profile.country_region) countryRegion,c.cost_mode costMode,case when c.cost_mode='MONTHLY' then c.unit_cost end monthlyCost,c.standard_work_days standardWorkDays from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join sys_dept company on company.parent_id=100 and company.del_flag='0' and (company.dept_id=d.dept_id or find_in_set(company.dept_id,d.ancestors)) left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id left join biz_staff_cost_policy c on c.policy_id=#{policyId} and c.user_id=u.user_id where u.user_id=#{userId}
select user_id userId,effective_from effectiveFrom,member_role memberRole from biz_project_member_role_period where project_id=#{projectId} order by effective_from
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_member_role_period(project_id,user_id,effective_from,member_role,operator_name,created_at) values(#{projectId},#{userId},#{effectiveFrom},#{role},#{operator},now()) on duplicate key update member_role=values(member_role),operator_name=values(operator_name),created_at=now()

insert ignore into biz_project_member_cost_period(project_id,user_id,user_name,member_role,joined_date,left_date) select project_id,user_id,user_name_snapshot,member_role,joined_date,left_date from biz_project_member where project_id=#{projectId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='1' and joined_date is not null and left_date is not null
mapper.select: select user_id userId,user_name userName,member_role memberRole,joined_date joinedDate,left_date leftDate,'1' status from biz_project_member_cost_period where project_id=#{projectId}

select project_id from biz_project where del_flag='0' and cost_policy_version='MEMBER_DAYS_V1' and coalesce(accounting_state,'OPEN')<>'CLOSED' and coalesce(actual_start_date,plan_start_date)<=current_date()
mapper.sql: project_id projectId,user_id userId,user_name userName,biz_date bizDate,amount,currency,pricing_status pricingStatus,issue,rate_policy_id ratePolicyId,calendar_id calendarId,basis_json basisJson,concat(user_name,' · 工作日成本') componentName,basis_json calculationDetail
mapper.select: select from biz_project_member_day_cost where project_id=#{projectId} order by biz_date,user_id
select from biz_project_member_day_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} order by user_id
mapper.delete: delete from biz_project_member_day_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate}
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_project_member_day_cost where project_id=#{projectId} and pricing_status='PENDING'

select date_format(r.biz_date,'%Y-%m-%d') from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=#{projectId} and r.is_current='1' and not exists(select 1 from biz_project_daily_result_item i where i.result_id=r.result_id and i.component_code='PERSONNEL_COST' and i.calculation_detail like '成员参与期间有效工作日%')
